description: This file is part of the Notesnook project and serves as the bootstrap or initialization script for the web application. It manages route handling, feature checks, and application startup procedures.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Determines the current route based on the URL path, handling special cases like session expiry and registration redirects.

methods.name: redirectToRegistration
methods.description: Redirects to the registration page if the route is not recognized and certain conditions are met.

methods.name: isSessionExpired
methods.description: Checks if the user session has expired and redirects to the session expired route if necessary.

methods.name: checkPrerequisites
methods.description: Verifies browser support for necessary APIs and secure context before initializing the app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes feature checks, verifies prerequisites, determines the route, loads the main component, and sets up logging.

methods.name: shouldSkipInitiation
methods.description: Determines if the app should skip the initiation process based on theme builder mode or local storage.
